root.name: モンデリーズ・インターナショナル

companies.name: クラフト・ハインツ
companies.sub: 知的財産の相互許諾先

relations.text: 2012年の分離後、互いに知的財産の使用を許諾し合っている
relations.text_en: The two companies granted each other licenses to use intellectual property after the 2012 spin-off

source.label: モンデリーズ 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.quote: In our agreement with Kraft Foods Group, Inc. (which is now part of The Kraft Heinz Company), we each granted the other party various licenses to use certain of our and their respective intellectual property rights in named jurisdictions following the spin-off of our North American grocery business in 2012.

companies.name: キューリグ・ドクターペッパー

relations.text: KDPの持株比率が2023年第1四半期に5%を下回り、会計処理を変更した
relations.text_en: Mondelez's KDP stake fell below 5% in the first quarter of 2023 and the accounting treatment changed

source.label: モンデリーズ 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.quote: During the first quarter of 2023, our ownership in KDP fell to below 5% of the outstanding shares, resulting in a change in the accounting for our KDP investment, from equity method investment accounting to accounting for equity interests with readily determinable fair values as we no longer retained significant influence

companies.name: JDEピーツ
companies.sub: コーヒー会社・元出資先

relations.text: 2024年第4四半期にJDEピーツの残り株式をJABに売却した
relations.text_en: Sold its remaining shares in JDE Peet's to JAB in the fourth quarter of 2024

source.label: モンデリーズ 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.quote: In the fourth quarter of 2024, we sold our remaining 85.9 million shares in JDEP to JAB.

relations.text: KDPによるJDEP買収の合意を受け、JABから1億4,500万ユーロの現金支払を受けた
relations.text_en: Received a EUR 145 million cash payment from JAB after the KDP and JDEP acquisition agreement

source.label: モンデリーズ 10-K(2025年12月31日)
source.quote: As a result of that definitive agreement, we became entitled to a cash payment of €145 million ($169 million) from JAB Holding Company (“JAB”) that we received in 2025.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
